subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: Should OpenClaw add a channel-visible, session-level command that switches a conversation's active agent without editing bindings or restarting Gateway?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent contract changes routing, authorization, persistence, rollback, and cross-agent isolation semantics that automation should not choose.

options.title: Design Gated Session Switch
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a small design covering authorized senders, persistence, rollback/audit, static default routing, and switched-routing tests.

options.title: Keep Bindings Static
options.body: Decline runtime channel switching and keep configured bindings plus restart or approved reload as the supported cross-agent routing model.

options.title: Expose Routing Extension First
options.body: Require a generic channel/session-routing extension point before shipping a concrete core `/agent` command.

recommendation.title: Design Gated Session Switch
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a small design covering authorized senders, persistence, rollback/audit, static default routing, and switched-routing tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal runs through the multi-agent routing foundation, docs, and TUI agent-switch surface this feature would extend.
